list.title: Announcements
list.description: Write a message and send it as an in-app notification to selected people, groups, roles, or everyone — now or at a set time.

field.title: Title
field.bodyHint: Plain text, up to {{max}} characters. Recipients see the full text when they open the notification.

audience.all: Everyone in the tenant (all users who can sign in)

create.title: New announcement
create.description: Save it as a draft first, then send it after checking the content and recipients.

update.publishedNotice: This announcement has been sent (scheduled or paused): changes only affect future sends.

publish.title: Send announcement
publish.confirmImmediate: Send "{{title}}" to its recipients now? It can't be edited afterwards, only revoked.
publish.confirmScheduled: Send "{{title}}" to its recipients at {{at}}? You can pause it or change the time before then.

delete.title: Delete announcement
delete.confirm: Delete "{{title}}"? A scheduled announcement stops sending. You can restore it from the trash.

revoke.title: Revoke this send
revoke.confirm: Recipients' notifications for it are deleted, and even those who read it can no longer open it. The send record is kept.

dispatch.title: Send history
dispatch.tooManyRecipients: {{count}} recipients exceed the limit of {{max}}; nothing was sent
